listingTitle: Reuse locale formatters in JavaScript loops
title: Reuse locale formatters in JavaScript loops
why: Repeated toLocaleString, toLocaleDateString, or toLocaleTimeString calls resolve equivalent locale data and options on every iteration.
suggestion: Create the matching Intl formatter once outside the loop and reuse its format method.
limitations: Only direct locale-formatting calls with no arguments or literal locale and simple literal options inside recognized braced loops are reported.
Dynamic locales and options, formatter wrappers, receiver types, loop frequency, and engine-specific optimizations are not inferred.
